image_prompts: A neatly arranged display of various fruits, some slightly more prominent than others
Two cups of tea, one green and one black, with the green tea cup slightly forward

words.image_desc_cn: 展示对水果和茶的偏好。
words.usage: v. (过去式 preferred, 过去分词 preferred)
words.collocations: prefer A to B; prefer doing sth.; prefer to do sth.

examples.en: I prefer summer to winter because I love swimming in the sea.
examples.cn: 我喜欢夏天胜过冬天，因为我喜欢在海里游泳。

socratic_questions.question: 如果让你在两个选项中选择一个，你内心更倾向于哪个？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示在两者或多者之间，你觉得哪个更好或更想要。

image_prompts: A notebook with handwritten musical notes and text on lined paper, a pen nearby
A karaoke screen displaying scrolling text synchronized with music, colorful background
words.image_desc_en: A notebook with handwritten lyrics and a karaoke screen displaying scrolling lyrics.

words.collocations: write lyrics, sing the lyrics, memorize lyrics
words.preposition_combos: lyrics to a song, lyrics about love

examples.cn: 她今年为学校的新歌写了歌词。

sentences: He is trying to memorize the ___ to his favorite pop song.

image_prompts: A map of Australia highlighting its major cities and landmarks.
A kangaroo hopping across the outback with Ayers Rock in the background.
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting Australia's geography and wildlife.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘澳大利亚的地理和野生动物的图像。
words.meaning_cn: 澳大利亚的；澳大利亚人的

examples.cn: 他有澳大利亚口音，这很容易辨认。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人来自悉尼或墨尔本，我们通常会用哪个形容词来描述他们的国籍？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是一个位于南半球的国家。

sentences: She enjoys learning about ___ animals like kangaroos and koalas.

image_prompts: A map showing two cities very close to each other, connected by a dotted line
A row of houses, with one house directly next to another, sharing a wall
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations showing the concept of adjacency.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示邻近概念的插图。
words.usage: 形容词，表示某物与另一物在空间上非常接近。
words.collocations: adjacent building, adjacent room, adjacent area

examples.en: Our school is adjacent to a large park, which is convenient.
examples.cn: 我们的学校毗邻一个大型公园，这很方便。

examples.cn: 图书馆在校园里与科学楼相邻。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的座位旁边是你的好朋友，你会用哪个词来描述你们座位之间的位置关系？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示两者紧挨着，非常靠近。

sentences: The two buildings are ___, so it's easy to walk between them.

image_prompts: A circuit board with glowing components, close-up shot
A digital clock displaying the time with bright LED numbers
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations related to electronic devices and components.
words.image_desc_cn: 与电子设备和元件相关的插图。
words.collocations: electronic device, electronic music, electronic dictionary

examples.en: I prefer to read electronic books because they are convenient.
examples.cn: 我更喜欢阅读电子书，因为它们很方便。

examples.en: The electronic dictionary is a useful tool for learning English.
examples.cn: 电子词典是学习英语的有用工具。

socratic_questions.question: 什么类型的设备使用电池或插头来运行，并且通常包含屏幕或芯片？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述的是依靠电流运作的设备。

sentences: My father bought a new ___ piano as a birthday gift for me.

image_prompts: A question mark formed by clouds in a blue sky, suggesting uncertainty
A detective holding a magnifying glass over a clue, deep in thought
words.image_desc_en: A visual representation of uncertainty and deduction.
words.image_desc_cn: 不确定性和推理的视觉表现。
words.usage: v. (过去式 supposed, 过去分词 supposed)
words.collocations: suppose that, suppose to be, I suppose

examples.en: I suppose it will rain tomorrow because the sky is cloudy.
examples.cn: 我猜明天会下雨，因为天空多云。

examples.en: We suppose he is telling the truth, but we aren't sure.
examples.cn: 我们认为他说的是实话，但我们不确定。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你不确定某件事是否真实，你会怎么表达你的想法？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表达你认为某事可能发生或真实的观点，但没有确凿的证据。

sentences: I ___ you're right, but I still have some doubts about it.

image_prompts: A freshly paved road with no cracks or bumps, reflecting sunlight
A polished river stone with a glossy surface, resting on sand
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting a smooth road and a smooth stone.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘光滑道路和光滑石头的插图。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 光滑的；平稳的；顺利的 v. (smoothed, smoothed) 使平滑；使顺利
words.collocations: smooth surface, smooth ride, smooth process

examples.en: The lake was very smooth, like a mirror reflecting the sky.
examples.cn: 湖面非常光滑，像一面镜子一样映照着天空。

examples.en: We hope our trip to Beijing will be a smooth journey.
examples.cn: 我们希望我们去北京的旅行将会是一次顺利的旅程。

socratic_questions.question: 当你触摸一块没有粗糙感，非常平整的石头时，你会用什么词来形容它的表面？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容表面没有凹凸不平。

sentences: The ice skater moved across the ___ surface of the rink.

image_prompts: A neatly folded spare blanket on a guest bed, soft lighting
A spare tire in the trunk of a car, tools neatly arranged beside it
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations of a spare blanket and a spare tire.
words.image_desc_cn: 备用毯子和备用轮胎的插图。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 备用的；空闲的；v. 抽出；饶恕
words.usage: adj. / v. (过去式 spared, 过去分词 spared)
words.collocations: spare time, spare parts, spare room

examples.en: Do you have any spare time this weekend for the party?
examples.cn: 你这个周末有空闲时间参加聚会吗？

examples.en: We keep a spare key under the flower pot near the door.
examples.cn: 我们把备用钥匙放在门边的花盆下面。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有多余的时间，你会选择做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词可以描述多余的、不被占用的时间。

sentences: I always keep a ___ pen in my bag in case one runs out.

image_prompts: A clapperboard with the word 'Action' written on it, film reel in the background
A megaphone resting on a director's chair with a film set visible in the distance
words.image_desc_en: A clapperboard and a megaphone on a director's chair represent the role of a director.
words.image_desc_cn: 场记板和导演椅上的扩音器代表了导演的角色。
words.collocations: film director, board of directors

examples.en: The director gave instructions to the actors before the scene started.
examples.cn: 导演在场景开始前给演员们做了指示。

examples.en: She wants to be a film director when she grows up.
examples.cn: 她长大后想成为一名电影导演。

socratic_questions.question: 谁负责电影的整体拍摄和指导演员？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个人决定了电影的最终呈现效果，并指导演员的表演。

sentences: The film's success is largely due to the talented ___ and his vision.

image_prompts: A sturdy suitcase open on a luggage rack, travel stickers affixed to its exterior
A glass display cabinet filled with antique porcelain dolls, soft lighting
words.image_desc_en: A suitcase and a display cabinet.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个手提箱和一个展示柜。
words.collocations: in case, in any case, a case of

examples.en: I always keep an umbrella in my school bag just in case.
examples.cn: 我总是在书包里放一把雨伞，以防万一。

examples.en: The police are investigating the robbery case that happened last night.
examples.cn: 警察正在调查昨晚发生的抢劫案。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你要打包行李去旅行，你会用什么来装你的衣服和物品？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是一种用于携带物品的容器，也指代某种事件或问题。

sentences: She packed her clothes carefully into the ___ before the trip.

image_prompts: A wilted flower lying on cracked pavement, raindrops falling
A donation box overflowing with coins and bills, a sign reading 'Help Others'
words.image_desc_en: A wilted flower and a donation box.
words.image_desc_cn: 一朵枯萎的花和捐款箱。
words.meaning_cn: n. 怜悯，同情；遗憾的事 v. 同情，怜悯
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 pitied, 过去分词 pitied)
words.collocations: take pity on, feel pity for

examples.en: I felt pity for the stray cat that was cold and hungry.
examples.cn: 我同情那只又冷又饿的流浪猫。

examples.en: It's a pity that the school trip was cancelled due to rain.
examples.cn: 因为下雨学校旅行取消了，真可惜。

socratic_questions.question: 看到别人遭遇不幸，你心里会产生什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉是为别人的痛苦而难过，希望他们能好起来。

sentences: I felt great ___ for the lost puppy in the heavy rain.

image_prompts: A calculator displaying a final sum after a series of calculations
A pie chart showing 100% completion, all segments filled in
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing the final sum and complete percentage.
words.image_desc_cn: 表示总和以及完整百分比的插图。
words.usage: adj. / n. / v. (过去式 totaled, 过去分词 totaled) / adv. totally
words.collocations: total cost, total number, in total

examples.en: The total cost for the school trip is about 200 yuan.
examples.cn: 这次学校旅行的总费用大约是200元。

examples.en: The total number of students in our class is fifty-five.
examples.cn: 我们班的学生总数是五十五个。

socratic_questions.question: 如果把所有东西加起来，最后得到的那个数是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指的是所有部分加在一起的最终结果。

image_prompts: A calculator displaying a final sum after several numbers were added, bright screen
A stack of coins of different denominations, with a label showing the combined value
words.image_desc_en: A calculator showing the total sum and a stack of coins representing the total value.
words.image_desc_cn: 计算器显示总和，以及一堆硬币代表总价值。
words.collocations: calculate in total, cost in total, add up in total

examples.en: The trip cost 2,000 yuan in total, including food and tickets.
examples.cn: 这次旅行总共花费了2000元，包括食物和门票。

examples.en: We have 30 students in total in our English club this year.
examples.cn: 今年我们的英语俱乐部总共有30名学生。

socratic_questions.question: 如果把所有东西加起来，最后得到的数量或金额，用哪个短语来表示？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示最终的总数，强调所有部分加在一起的结果。

sentences: The books cost 100 yuan ___ , which is quite reasonable.
___, the project took us three months to complete.

image_prompts: A grand chess master trophy on a polished wooden table, chessboard blurred in background
A conductor's baton raised dramatically in front of a symphony orchestra, stage lights
words.image_desc_en: A chess master trophy and a conductor's baton.
words.image_desc_cn: 国际象棋大师奖杯和指挥棒。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 mastered, 过去分词 mastered)
words.collocations: chess master, master a skill

examples.en: He is a master of the English language, writing beautiful poems.
examples.cn: 他是一位英语大师，写出优美的诗歌。

examples.en: It takes time and effort to master a new musical instrument.
examples.cn: 精通一种新的乐器需要时间和努力。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在某个领域达到了非常高的水平，人们会怎么称呼你？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容在某个领域技艺精湛的人。

sentences: She wants to ___ the art of cooking delicious meals for her family.

image_prompts: A golden trophy on a pedestal, spotlight shining on it
A certificate of achievement with a gold seal, displayed on a wall
words.image_desc_en: A trophy and a certificate represent praise.
words.image_desc_cn: 奖杯和证书代表赞扬。
words.meaning_cn: v. 赞扬；表扬 n. 赞扬；称赞
words.usage: v. (过去式 praised, 过去分词 praised); n.
words.collocations: praise for, sing the praises of

examples.en: The teacher gave her praise for her excellent performance in the exam.
examples.cn: 老师因为她在考试中的出色表现而赞扬了她。

examples.en: We should praise students who work hard and make progress.
examples.cn: 我们应该表扬努力学习并取得进步的学生。

socratic_questions.question: 当你的朋友帮助了你，你可能会对他说什么，来表达你的感激和认可？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表达了对他人行为的肯定和欣赏。

A stack of old photo albums on a dusty shelf, sunlight streaming through a window

words.collocations: easily recall, difficult to recall, recall a memory, recall an event

examples.en: I can't recall the name of the restaurant we went to.
examples.cn: 我记不起我们去的那家餐厅的名字了。

examples.en: She tried to recall what happened on the day of the accident.
examples.cn: 她试图回忆起事故那天发生了什么。

socratic_questions.question: 当你努力想想起昨天发生的事情，你在做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示努力在脑海中重现过去的经历或信息。

image_prompts: A first aid kit next to a bandaged knee, antiseptic wipes nearby
A close-up of a small cut on a finger with a drop of blood
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting a physical injury, such as a cut or scrape.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘身体损伤的图片，例如割伤或擦伤。

words.collocations: serious wound, minor wound, wound deeply, heal a wound

examples.en: He had a deep wound on his leg after the accident.
examples.cn: 事故发生后，他的腿上有一个很深的伤口。

A twisted ankle with an ice pack on it, swelling visible
words.image_desc_en: A scraped knee and a twisted ankle, both indicating physical discomfort.
words.image_desc_cn: 擦伤的膝盖和扭伤的脚踝，都表示身体上的不适。

examples.cn: 牙医的预约非常痛苦，但对我的健康是必要的。

examples.en: It was a painful loss when our team lost the final game.
examples.cn: 当我们的队伍输掉决赛时，这是一个痛苦的损失。

socratic_questions.question: 当你摔倒擦破膝盖时，你会感到什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容身体或精神上让人感觉不舒服的。

sentences: The breakup was a very ___ experience for her, and she needed time.

image_prompts: A road sign indicating a detour, suggesting a change of plans
A chess board with a piece moved to a different square, implying a changed strategy
words.image_desc_en: A detour sign and a chess board with a changed move, representing a change of plans or strategy.
words.image_desc_cn: 绕行标志和棋盘上改变的棋子，代表计划或策略的改变。

examples.cn: 下雨了。如果是那样的话，我会带把伞。

socratic_questions.question: 如果得知明天的体育课取消了，你会怎么说？

sentences: You don't have enough money; ___ , I will lend you some.

image_prompts: A battlefield with destroyed tanks and smoke rising, a desolate landscape
A dove carrying an olive branch flying over a broken city, symbolizing peace after conflict
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting conflict and its aftermath, contrasted with symbols of peace.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘冲突及其后果的图像，与和平的象征形成对比。
words.usage: n. (wars) 战争; v. (warred, warred) 发动战争
words.collocations: declare war, world war, war against
words.preposition_combos: in war, during the war, after the war

examples.en: The country suffered greatly during the long and terrible war.
examples.cn: 这个国家在漫长而可怕的战争中遭受了巨大的苦难。

examples.en: They decided to war against the neighboring country for resources.
examples.cn: 他们决定为了资源向邻国发动战争。

socratic_questions.question: 如果两个国家之间发生了大规模的武装冲突，导致人员伤亡和财产损失，这通常被称为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是国家或团体之间使用武力解决争端的状态。

sentences: The two nations were at ___ for many years, causing much suffering.

image_prompts: A fallen tree branch lying on a forest floor covered with leaves
A glue stick with its cap off, ready to be used on paper
words.image_desc_en: A fallen branch and a glue stick.
words.image_desc_cn: 一根掉落的树枝和一个胶棒。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 stuck, 过去分词 stuck)
words.collocations: a walking stick, stick to

examples.en: I found a long stick in the park yesterday afternoon.
examples.cn: 昨天下午我在公园里找到了一根长长的棍子。

examples.en: Please stick this notice on the bulletin board carefully now.
examples.cn: 请现在小心地把这张通知贴在公告栏上。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想把两张纸固定在一起，你会用什么？或者你在森林里走路时，可能会捡起什么细长的东西？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词既可以表示一种细长的物体，也可以表示粘贴的动作。

fill_blank.sentences: The teacher asked us to ___ the photos in our notebooks.

image_prompts: A piece of paper glued firmly to a wooden board, strong adhesive
A compass needle pointing steadily in one direction, unwavering
words.image_desc_en: Adhering firmly to something; remaining constant or faithful.
words.image_desc_cn: 牢固地粘附；保持不变或忠诚。

words.collocations: stick to a plan, stick to the rules, stick to your promise

socratic_questions.question: 如果你已经做了一个决定，并且相信它是正确的，你会怎么做？

image_prompts: A feather gently drifting downwards in a sunlit room
A winding staircase leading downwards into a dimly lit basement
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting downward movement or direction.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘向下运动或方向的插图。
words.collocations: down the street, down the river, feel down
words.preposition_combos: down with (生病), down on (批评)

examples.en: The price of that book has come down recently.
examples.cn: 那本书的价格最近降下来了。

examples.en: She felt a little down after failing the math test.
examples.cn: 数学考试不及格后，她感到有点沮丧。

socratic_questions.question: 如果原本挂在墙上的画掉到了地上，它现在在哪里？

words.collocations: have a dialog, start a dialog, continue the dialog

socratic_questions.question: 在电影或戏剧中，角色之间进行的交流是什么？

sentences: The book includes a fascinating ___ between two main characters.

image_prompts: A film reel showing the final scene with the words 'The End' superimposed
A book with its last page turned, showing a period at the end of the final sentence
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations of the conclusion of a movie and a book.
words.image_desc_cn: 电影和书籍的结尾插图。
words.usage: n. The way in which something ends.
words.collocations: happy ending, sad ending, abrupt ending

examples.en: The ending of the story was very surprising to all readers.
examples.cn: 这个故事的结局让所有读者都感到非常惊讶。

examples.en: We watched the movie until its very exciting ending last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚我们观看了这部电影，直到它非常精彩的结局。

socratic_questions.question: 一部电影或一本书的最后部分通常被称为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它表示故事或事件的结束。

sentences: The film had a very unexpected ___ that left the audience speechless.

image_prompts: A television screen displaying a scene of penguins in Antarctica, icy landscape
A stack of DVDs with covers depicting various nature scenes and historical events
words.image_desc_en: A film or television program presenting the facts about a person or event.
words.image_desc_cn: 呈现关于人物或事件的事实的电影或电视节目。
words.collocations: watch a documentary, nature documentary, historical documentary

examples.en: I watched a fascinating documentary about the Amazon rainforest last night.
examples.cn: 我昨晚看了一部关于亚马逊雨林的精彩纪录片。

examples.en: The school showed a documentary on climate change to raise awareness.
examples.cn: 学校播放了一部关于气候变化的纪录片，以提高人们的意识。

socratic_questions.question: 如果我想了解某个真实事件或人物，我会看什么类型的电影？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这类电影通常基于事实，而不是虚构的故事。

sentences: She enjoys watching a ___ about animals in their natural habitats.

image_prompts: A stage with colorful lighting and theatrical props, curtains drawn
A stack of play scripts with different titles, quill pen resting on top
words.image_desc_en: A stage with props and play scripts with a quill pen.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个有道具的舞台，以及带有羽毛笔的剧本。
words.collocations: school drama, TV drama, historical drama

examples.en: The school drama club is putting on a new play this year.
examples.cn: 学校戏剧社今年正在上演一部新剧。

examples.en: She enjoys watching historical dramas on TV in her free time.
examples.cn: 她喜欢在空闲时间看电视上的历史剧。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个故事在舞台上表演，通常被称为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词通常与舞台表演和剧本有关。

sentences: The students are practicing for the school ___ competition next month.

image_prompts: A large bowl overflowing with ripe, red strawberries, glistening in sunlight
A field of golden wheat stretching to the horizon under a clear blue sky
words.image_desc_en: Abundance or a large quantity of something.
words.image_desc_cn: 某物的丰富或大量。
words.collocations: plenty of time, plenty of food, plenty of opportunities

examples.en: We have plenty of time to finish the project before the deadline.
examples.cn: 我们在截止日期前有充足的时间完成这个项目。

examples.en: There's plenty of food for everyone at the party tonight.
examples.cn: 今晚的聚会有足够的食物供大家享用。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有很多时间来准备考试，你会用哪个词来形容你的时间？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示“足够多”，甚至“过剩”的时间。

sentences: There is ___ of space in the new classroom for all the students.

image_prompts: A large bowl overflowing with ripe red apples, autumn sunlight
A field filled with blooming sunflowers stretching to the horizon
words.image_desc_en: Abundant quantity or amount.
words.image_desc_cn: 大量的，充足的。
words.usage: 短语，表示“大量的，充足的”，后接可数名词复数或不可数名词。
words.collocations: plenty of time, plenty of food, plenty of opportunities

examples.en: We have plenty of time to finish the project before the deadline.
examples.cn: 我们有充足的时间在截止日期前完成这个项目。

examples.en: There are plenty of books in the library for you to read.
examples.cn: 图书馆里有大量的书供你阅读。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有很多时间来准备考试，你会用哪个短语来形容这种状态？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示“足够多”，可以满足需求。

sentences: There is ___ water in the bottle; you don't need to buy more.

image_prompts: A wooden door completely closed, a dark room behind it
A metal gate with a padlock, preventing entry to a garden
words.image_desc_en: A closed door and a locked gate.
words.image_desc_cn: 一扇关着的门和一把锁着的栅栏门。
words.usage: v. (过去式 shut, 过去分词 shut)
words.collocations: shut down, shut up, shut in

examples.en: Please shut the window; it's getting cold in the room.
examples.cn: 请关上窗户，房间里越来越冷了。

examples.en: Remember to shut all the doors before you leave the house.
examples.cn: 记住离开家之前要关好所有的门。

socratic_questions.question: 当你不想让外面的声音传进来时，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作表示阻止声音进入。

sentences: I need to ___ the book because I have to go now.

image_prompts: A red emergency switch with the words 'shut off' above it, dark background
A dripping faucet with a wrench turning the valve to 'shut off' the water
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting the action of stopping something, especially a machine or flow.
words.image_desc_cn: 图片描绘了停止某物的动作，特别是机器或流动。
words.usage: v. (过去式 shut off, 过去分词 shut off)
words.collocations: shut off the engine, shut off the power, shut off automatically

examples.en: Please shut off the lights when you leave the classroom, thanks.
examples.cn: 离开教室时请关掉灯，谢谢。

examples.en: Remember to shut off the water heater before you go on vacation.
examples.cn: 记住在去度假之前关闭热水器。

socratic_questions.question: 当你离开房间时，你会做什么来节约能源？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 我们需要停止电器的运行，以节省能源。

sentences: Don't forget to ___ the computer before leaving the office.

image_prompts: A comic book cover featuring a figure with a flowing cape and a symbol
A child's drawing of a figure with extraordinary abilities, flying above buildings
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting a superhero figure in a comic book and a child's drawing.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘漫画书中超级英雄形象和儿童绘画的插图。
words.collocations: become a superhero, superhero movie, superhero costume
words.preposition_combos: as a superhero, like a superhero

examples.en: My brother dreams to be a superhero to save the world.
examples.cn: 我弟弟梦想成为一个超级英雄来拯救世界。

examples.en: The movie is about a superhero who can fly very fast.
examples.cn: 这部电影讲述的是一个能飞得非常快的超级英雄。

socratic_questions.question: 想象一下，一个拥有超能力，可以帮助人们对抗坏人的角色，你会想到什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个角色通常拥有非凡的力量和勇气，保护弱小。

sentences: He dressed up as a ___ for the school's Halloween party.

image_prompts: A calendar with some dates circled randomly, indicating occasional events
A weather vane occasionally pointing in a different direction than usual
words.image_desc_en: Calendar with random dates circled; weather vane changing direction irregularly.
words.image_desc_cn: 日历上随机圈出一些日期；风向标不规则地改变方向。

examples.en: I go to the library once in a while to read books.
examples.cn: 我偶尔去图书馆看书。

examples.en: We eat out once in a while when we are too busy.
examples.cn: 当我们太忙时，我们偶尔出去吃饭。

socratic_questions.question: 你并不是每天都做这件事，但也不是完全不做，频率不高，你会怎么描述？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示不是经常发生，但也不是从不发生。

sentences: I visit my grandparents ___ to catch up on their lives.

image_prompts: A glowing lightbulb above a stack of books, representing a bright idea
A complex circuit board with many interconnected components, symbolizing advanced thinking
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of intelligence, such as a bright idea and a complex system.
words.image_desc_cn: 智能的可视化表现，例如一个聪明的想法和一个复杂的系统。
words.collocations: highly intelligent, extremely intelligent, artificially intelligent

examples.en: She is an intelligent student who always gets good grades.
examples.cn: 她是一个聪明的学生，总是取得好成绩。

examples.en: The intelligent machine can solve complex problems quickly and efficiently.
examples.cn: 这台智能机器可以快速有效地解决复杂问题。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人能迅速理解新事物并解决难题，你会怎么形容他？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容一个人有很强的学习和思考能力。

sentences: An ___ student always asks insightful questions in class.

image_prompts: A lightbulb illuminating above a stack of books, representing understanding
A hand touching a soft, textured fabric, representing the sense of touch
words.image_desc_en: A lightbulb and a hand touching fabric.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个灯泡和一只手触摸织物。
words.usage: n. v. (过去式 sensed, 过去分词 sensed)
words.collocations: common sense, sense of humor, make sense

examples.en: I have a strong sense that something wonderful is going to happen.
examples.cn: 我强烈地感觉到将会有美好的事情发生。

examples.en: It makes sense to study hard for the upcoming important exam.
examples.cn: 为即将到来的重要考试努力学习是有道理的。

socratic_questions.question: 当你觉得某件事可能要发生，但你无法确定时，你会用哪个词来描述这种预感？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示一种直觉或预感，不一定是基于事实的。

sentences: She has a good ___ of humor and always makes us laugh.

image_prompts: A single wilted flower lying on a gray stone surface, raindrops visible
An empty swing set swaying gently in a deserted playground, overcast sky
words.image_desc_en: Visuals representing feelings of sorrow and loneliness.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表悲伤和孤独感的视觉效果。
words.collocations: feel sadness, express sadness, overcome sadness
words.preposition_combos: a feeling of sadness, in sadness

examples.en: The movie showed the sadness of losing a loved one.
examples.cn: 这部电影展现了失去亲人的悲伤。

examples.en: She felt a deep sadness after her best friend moved away.
examples.cn: 她最好的朋友搬走后，她感到深深的悲伤。

socratic_questions.question: 当你考试没考好，或者和朋友吵架之后，你通常会感受到什么情绪？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种情绪通常与失落和不快乐有关。

sentences: A wave of ___ washed over her when she heard the news.

image_prompts: A cracked porcelain doll lying on a dusty floor, one arm broken off
A wilting rose with thorns, several petals fallen, dark background
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting physical or emotional suffering.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘身体或情感痛苦的图像。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 pained, 过去分词 pained)
words.collocations: feel pain, in pain, cause pain

examples.en: I felt a sharp pain in my leg during the football match.
examples.cn: 在足球比赛中，我感到腿部一阵剧痛。

examples.en: The breakup caused her great pain, but she will recover.
examples.cn: 分手给她带来了巨大的痛苦，但她会恢复的。

socratic_questions.question: 当你摔倒擦破膝盖时，或者当你最好的朋友搬走时，你有什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉是不愉快的，可能是身体上的，也可能是情感上的。

sentences: She felt a sharp ___ in her stomach after eating too much.
The doctor asked him to describe the ___ he was experiencing.

image_prompts: A calm lake with a perfect mirror image of the mountains above
A shiny metal surface showing a distorted image of a nearby object
words.image_desc_en: Images showing reflection in water and on a metal surface.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示水面和金属表面反射的图像。
words.usage: v. (过去式 reflected, 过去分词 reflected); reflection n.
words.collocations: reflect on/upon, reflect light, reflect an image

examples.en: The clear water reflects the blue sky and white clouds.
examples.cn: 清澈的水面映照着蓝天和白云。

examples.en: We should reflect on our mistakes and learn from them.
examples.cn: 我们应该反思我们的错误并从中学习。

socratic_questions.question: 当你平静地看着湖面时，你会看到什么？或者，当你在考试后，你会做什么来让自己进步？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 湖面会呈现景象的镜像；考试后需要对自己的表现进行回顾和思考。

sentences: The mirror ___ her face clearly, showing every detail.

image_prompts: A conveyor belt transporting packages in a warehouse, packages blurred to show motion
A time-lapse of clouds drifting across a blue sky, indicating movement
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations of objects in motion.
words.image_desc_cn: 物体运动的插图。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 移动的；令人感动的
words.collocations: moving story, moving experience, moving target

examples.en: The moving train passed by so quickly, it was a blur.
examples.cn: 移动的火车飞速驶过，只留下模糊的影子。

examples.en: It was a moving speech that brought tears to everyone's eyes.
examples.cn: 这是一个令人感动的演讲，让每个人都热泪盈眶。

socratic_questions.question: 什么类型的电影或故事会让你觉得内心受到触动，甚至流泪？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容某事物能强烈地影响你的情感。

sentences: The film was so ___ that many people in the audience cried.

image_prompts: A spotlight shining on an empty stage with musical instruments
A robotic arm completing a complex assembly line task in a factory
words.image_desc_en: An action or task being carried out, often with skill or precision.
words.image_desc_cn: 执行某项行动或任务，通常带有技巧或精确性。
words.collocations: perform a task, perform well, perform surgery, perform an experiment
words.preposition_combos: perform for (an audience), perform in (a play)

examples.en: The students will perform a play at the school festival.
examples.cn: 学生们将在学校的节日上表演一个戏剧。

examples.en: She needs to perform well on the exam to get a good grade.
examples.cn: 她需要在考试中表现出色才能获得好成绩。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个乐队在舞台上演奏音乐，或者一个医生在手术室里做手术，你会用哪个词来描述他们的行为？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词强调的是完成一项任务或进行一项表演。

sentences: The magician will ___ his best trick at the party tonight.

image_prompts: A giant sequoia tree with visible growth rings, representing a long lifespan
A photo album filled with pictures from different stages of life, from infancy to old age
words.image_desc_en: A tree's growth rings and a life's photo album represent a lifetime.
words.image_desc_cn: 树木的年轮和人生的相册代表一生。
words.collocations: in a lifetime, throughout a lifetime

examples.en: This experience will be remembered for a lifetime by everyone.
examples.cn: 这次经历将被每个人铭记一生。

examples.en: He dedicated his entire lifetime to helping those in need.
examples.cn: 他将自己的一生都奉献给了帮助那些需要帮助的人。

socratic_questions.question: 如果某件事持续了你从出生到现在的全部时间，你会用哪个词来形容？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示从生到死的时间长度。

sentences: She spent her entire ___ researching the effects of climate change.

image_prompts: A calendar page flipping to the last day of the month, marked with a large 'X'
A digital clock displaying 11:59:59 PM, with fireworks in the background
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of a deadline or completion point.
words.image_desc_cn: 截止日期或完成点的视觉表现。
words.collocations: by the end of the year, by the end of the week, by the end of the day
words.preposition_combos: by the end of + 时间段

examples.en: I will finish my homework by the end of this evening.
examples.cn: 我将在今天晚上结束前完成我的作业。

examples.en: She hopes to travel around China by the end of next year.
examples.cn: 她希望在明年年底前游遍中国。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想表达在某个时间段的最后期限前完成某事，你会用什么短语？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示时间段的终结。

sentences: We must submit our project ___ next Friday to get full marks.
